For the photos, we want warm natural light, a few wide shots that show the whole scene, and plenty of close details like hands, textures, and tools. For video, we're planning three short clips for social and one longer piece for the website, around 90 seconds. The budget is roughly where we expected, though rentals came in a little higher than last year. I'd like to lock the schedule by the end of next week, so please send me your availability and any concerns. If the weather turns, we have a backup date the following Tuesday. Overall, I think this is the strongest plan we've had, and I'm excited to see it come together.
